title: Ribasim-coupled surface-water application profile production admission

admission_target.purpose: Admit the smallest production SWAP5-side profile in which Ribasim is the sole accepted surface-water store/system owner and SWAP5 contributes only qualified process exchange through existing transaction semantics.
production_scope: Q4A stateless signed extended drainage/infiltration process
accepted external surface-water head binding into extended-signed controls
no additional SWAP surface-water committed state
existing serialized trial/commit/rollback and mass ledger

frozen_process_mapping.external_head_semantics: accepted Ribasim surface-water level in centimetres, supplied as interval forcing/control and never persisted as SWAP state
frozen_process_mapping.availability_semantics: If Ribasim cannot realize a requested outward transfer, the coupled trial must be rejected/recomposed from accepted origins; accept-with-clip is forbidden.

frozen_storage_geometry.representation: Q1H symmetric epsilon-area representation of legacy piecewise-linear STTAB
frozen_storage_geometry.decision_basis: Explicit production-profile design choice within the three Q1H-qualified epsilons. It is not claimed to be universally optimal or a hydrological accuracy tolerance.

nonlinear_weir_scope.note: Q1A V1/R2 falsified native exact hard-kink mapping; Q1A R3/R3L passed only the frozen linear BETAW=1 controlled-connector envelope.

ribasim_provenance.policy: Exact git SHA is primary authority. Production model metadata targeting the core must declare ribasim_version=2026.1.1. The Python/core version-string mismatch at this SHA is an upstream metadata seam and may not be used as sole provenance.

required_candidate_checks: Only the Q4A process file and Q4B drainage-response binding production mutations are imported from research.
A dedicated Ribasim-coupled serialized wrapper binds accepted external heads and never configures the internal fixed-weir context.
The wrapper rejects the fixed-weir optional-state layout before execution.
The wrapper rejects pre-populated drainage-response controls so external accepted heads remain the sole authority.
All configured levels use FMR_DRAIN_VARIANT_EXTENDED_SIGNED and finite accepted external heads.
Positive drainage and negative infiltration commit with exactly-once mass booking and hard mass closure.
Invalid profile, owner conflict, missing/mismatched/nonfinite external heads, and invalid process configuration fail before commit or rollback without revision/state mutation.
The coupled profile adds no persistent SWAP surface-water state.
Existing fixed-weir standalone preservation and F-PM14 preservation remain green.
Q1H epsilon=1e-5 representation bound is replayed exactly.
Ribasim provenance pin and Python/core metadata discrepancy are checked explicitly.
required_independent_qualification: Candidate production blobs must be frozen before independent qualification.
Independent qualification may add tests/evidence only and must not mutate src or reference.
O0/O2 equality for the signed exchange route.
Existing restart and transactional preservation must be replayed or dependency-preservation must be proven on the exact candidate tree.
Canonical promotion remains a separate admission gate after independent qualification.
nonclaims: No new SWAP surface-water storage state.
No automatic SWMAN=2 production implementation inside SWAP5.
No broad SWAP5-Ribasim network production claim beyond the frozen profile.
